reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents Forsage as an Ethereum money-making opportunity requiring a cryptocurrency wallet deposit and slot activation, while promoting unlimited income and earnings of 1000 Ethereum or more. It also frames upgrades as a way to earn more and avoid losing profits, with explicit no-risk and easy-income claims, although the speaker says income is not guaranteed and the records do not establish whether displayed amounts were paid.

citations.quote: Forsage is a crowdfunding international platform of new generation and the first ever smart contract with the marketing of type matrix
In Forsage X3, you get 100% of the payment to your ETF wallet from spots I and II. Spot III reopens the slot again and payment goes to your upline.
In Forsage X4, members who take two places below you in the first line go to your upline or they spill over to someone else on your team!
There is a system in place that incentivizes members to upgrade to higher slots in the matrix from the profits they already made, otherwise they can lose profits while you can earn extra profits.
The more slots you activate, the more ETH you can earn

opening.argument: The presentation expressly rejects the characterization of a get-rich-quick offer and tells viewers that income is not guaranteed and requires effort. That qualification matters: the speaker presents participation as a risk-bearing opportunity, not a certain result. The video also describes the system as transparent, with transactions viewable on the Ethereum blockchain, and says payments go directly to members' personal wallets. Those disclosures give viewers material information with which to assess the opportunity rather than concealing uncertainty or presenting guaranteed returns.

citations.quote: Income is not guaranteed, and if you want to earn a lot of Ethereum, then you need to put in the effort.
transaction information can be viewed at the link in forsage
100% of all Ethereum payments are sent instantly and directly to the members of Forsage

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account emphasizes promotional phrases such as “no risk” and “unlimited,” but it overlooks the later, explicit qualification that income is not guaranteed and effort is required. The presence of optimistic marketing language does not erase a clear risk disclosure. Nor do descriptions of slots and uplines, without evidence of deception or an actual loss, establish that the presentation itself is fraudulent.

citations.quote: Income is not guaranteed, and if you want to earn a lot of Ethereum, then you need to put in the effort.
It's important to realize Forsage is not a get-rich-quick scheme.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A disclaimer cannot neutralize the presentation's repeated assurances that the system has “zero risk,” offers “unlimited” income, and can produce 1000 Ethereum or more. The qualification is materially undermined by those stronger claims and by the instruction to deposit cryptocurrency and activate slots. Saying that transactions are visible does not show that participants will profit or avoid loss.

citations.quote: no one can run away with your money.
the income potential is literally unlimited!
To get started you need to install the Trust crypto Wallet PC and deposit enough earth there to register

opening.argument: The material can reasonably be understood as an operational presentation explaining how a blockchain smart contract and its slot structure work. It defines the system, describes the X3 and X4 arrangements, and explains how payments and reopened slots operate. The accompanying presentation explicitly asks viewers to watch a short video presentation, while the narration directs them to step-by-step tutorials for getting started. Explaining a system's mechanics and showing its workflow is not, by itself, proof that the presenter is certifying every outcome or making a deceptive promise.

citations.quote: the first ever smart contract with the marketing of type matrix
How does the Forsage work
please watch the step-by-step video tutorials on how to get started

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account treats the tutorial's subject matter as dispositive, but explaining a mechanism does not convert an instructional presentation into a scam. The narration supplies a structured account of slots, payments, and blockchain operation, and explicitly says income is not guaranteed. The evidence therefore supports an educational or operational reading, even if the presenter also describes possible earnings.

citations.quote: How does the Forsage work
Income is not guaranteed, and if you want to earn a lot of Ethereum, then you need to put in the effort.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not a neutral technical demonstration. The explanation is tied to instructions to install a wallet, deposit cryptocurrency, register, and activate slots, while the video promotes earning potential and directs viewers to contact the person who shared it. Describing mechanics does not change the fact that the demonstrated mechanism routes payments through slots and uplines.

citations.quote: To get started you need to install the Trust crypto Wallet PC and deposit enough earth there to register
contact the person who shared with you this video
Spot III reopens the slot again and payment goes to your upline.

opening.argument: The evidence can also be framed as promotion of a blockchain-based service with an explained payment and wallet workflow, rather than proof of a fraudulent scheme. The narration says the code is public, transactions can be viewed, and members control the private keys to their personal wallets. It does not establish that the creators take custody of members' cryptocurrency, request passwords or credentials, or guarantee a particular payout. Even the entry description refers to a smart contract, and the operational explanation identifies the assets and steps involved rather than concealing what participation requires.

citations.quote: the code is in the public domain transaction information can be viewed at the link in forsage
the founders of Forsage never take or store a member's cryptocurrency in any centralized location
stored in their personal Ethereum wallets, which they control the private keys
deposit enough earth there to register and then activate the amount of slots that you want one by one

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account identifies a deposit and a matrix, but those facts alone do not establish deceptive conduct. The video discloses the wallet deposit and slot activation process, describes public transaction records, and expressly denies guaranteed income. No supplied evidence shows a request for private credentials, undisclosed custody of funds, or a confirmed unpaid withdrawal, so the mechanism should not be treated as proven fraud.

citations.quote: transaction information can be viewed at the link in forsage
Income is not guaranteed
the founders of Forsage never take or store a member's cryptocurrency in any centralized location

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclosed mechanics are precisely the concern: viewers are told to deposit cryptocurrency and activate slots, with payments linked to positions below a member and an upline. Public code or wallet control does not show that the arrangement creates sustainable value or that participants will recover their deposits. The absence of a shown password request or confirmed loss does not negate the explicitly promoted recruitment-and-payment structure.
